intuition: With positive numbers, expanding the window increases its sum and shrinking it decreases the sum.

brute_force.approach: Sum every contiguous subarray and track the shortest one reaching target.

optimal.approach: Grow a sliding window until it reaches target, then shrink from the left while it remains valid.

edge_cases: No window may reach target, in which case return zero.
All values are positive, which makes window shrinking safe.
A single value may already reach the target.
